chunks: And comes your Lord, and the angels row on row,
ai.seo_question: What happens when Allah arrives on the Day of Judgment according to Surah Al-Fajr?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the imminent arrival of Allah's command and the orderly procession of angels, often interpreted as the manifestation of divine authority through the Imams or the finality of the Resurrection. The phrase 'saffan saffan' (row upon row) emphasizes the structured hierarchy of the celestial beings, reflecting the cosmic order established by God. This scene serves as a powerful reminder of accountability, linking the physical reality of the Day of Judgment with the spiritual readiness of the believer.
